baseline: Previously recorded Small with same policy; paired by ID and audio SHA256
limits: Existing regression fixtures, not unseen human gold. Include all long utterances without truncation or exclusion.

adaptive_followup.rule: Use 768 only when samples <= 768 * 320; otherwise use default full context before first decode
adaptive_followup.why: All four >15.36s quotations were lost with fixed 768; full context restored all four. Delayed-reference probes exposed late-speech loss.
adaptive_followup.scope: Follow-up selected after regression inspection; not an independent blind test
